supersedes: version 1, sha256 6f63f192dfb4b6c35835e4ca2b4247886afe4a1ba6b013a1b360b0c4b80ba6dc (fresh-Opus audit PARALLEL_TRIAL_AUDIT_BY_FRESH_OPUS said fix first; the trial had not launched)
cost_unit: ITE (Opus-input-equivalent tokens) as weighted by arena_analysis.py at the pinned commit, from raw per-model counts; never the account's percent-of-window figure

validity.every_model_call_must_carry_a_full_key: arm, stream, task, attempt, role (helpers: role=helper plus parent call id). One unkeyed or half-keyed call voids the run. There is no shared-overhead bucket inside a run.
validity.record_level_reconcile: for every claude -p pass: the CLI result envelope (modelUsage) against the transcript census of that session including <sid>/subagents/*; input-side shortfall at most 0.05 (helper_capture.RECONCILE_SHORT_MAX), no message id counted twice
validity.block_level_account_check: the account's own usage delta over the block against the sum of keyed ITE of every run in that block; reported, and a run is voided only if the account shows a switch of account or a usage drop (failover); it cannot attribute spend per arm

aggregation.pairing: each cell run is paired with the same arm's fresh control run started in the SAME block at the same moment, under the same block load
aggregation.pooled: ratio of sums over the cell's blocks: acceptance = sum accepted points / sum workload size; accepted_per_hour = sum accepted points / sum wall hours; cost_per_point = sum ITE / sum accepted points (a cell with 0 accepted points has cost_per_point infinite)
aggregation.speedup: pooled cell accepted_per_hour / pooled control accepted_per_hour
aggregation.cost_ratio: pooled cell cost_per_point / pooled control cost_per_point
aggregation.acceptance_drop: pooled control acceptance - pooled cell acceptance (negative is a gain)
aggregation.worst_block_drop: max over blocks of (control acceptance - cell acceptance) in that block

part_one.what_changes: helper allowance H: 0 (control) vs 2 (cell), N = 1, the 25 replay tasks in replay order
part_one.block_content: every block runs, for each of the four arms, one H=2 run and one H=0 run at once (8 runs)
part_one.block_order: arm-to-slice assignment shuffled per block with the seed
part_one.cutoff_wall_hours_per_run: max(12, 1.5 x that arm's measured replay wall hours for the same task set); the replay figure is written into the pin manifest before block 1
part_one.fallback_subset: the last 10 tasks in the total order (workload_size 10), chosen now; no subset may be picked after launch
part_one.part_one_does_not_gate_part_two: Part Two keeps H = 2 for every arm whatever Part One finds; an arm may decline helpers, and that shows as a measured zero

part_two.what_changes: streams N, with H = 2 in cell and control alike
part_two.block_content: every block runs, for each of the four arms, one run at N and one fresh N = 1 control run at once (8 runs)
part_two.block_order: N ladder order fixed (2 then 4); within an N, arm-to-slice assignment shuffled per block with the seed
part_two.dispatch_order: one seeded permutation of the 13 tasks (seed above), the same for every arm, every N and the control; a stream takes the first givable task in that order
part_two.task_green_at_dispatch: not dispatched; recorded as pre_green; it scores as accepted only if green on the final integrated tree; counted in the family sensitivity below
part_two.family_sensitivity: the verdict is computed twice: on all 13 tasks, and on the 10 without the family (workload_size 10). If the two verdicts differ, the cell reads hold, flagged family_confounded
part_two.accepted_point: task landed on integration main AND its hidden check green on the final integrated tree at drain
part_two.in_task_counts_at_13_tasks_2_blocks: pooled drop 0.10 allows at most 2 lost task-slots of 26; worst block 0.20 allows at most 2 lost tasks of 13
part_two.otherwise: hold: report the previous passing N as the measured setting; do not escalate
part_two.pass_means: escalate only; hold and stop are both not-pass
part_two.n4_runway_gate: the N=4 blocks run only if, after the N=2 blocks, the measured account burn per N=4 block (launch probe P11 scaled by the N=2 blocks' keyed ITE) fits the remaining runway above the 0.15 floor for 2 blocks; otherwise every arm's N=4 reads not_measured, decided by this formula and logged before any N=4 block
part_two.ralph_c_N4: run only if ralph_c_loop's two-member limit has been generalised to N members with its selftest green before block 1; otherwise ralph_c@N4 reads not_measured (never a fail, never a ceiling)

claims.ceiling: claimed only when N passes (escalate) and the next N stops. A hold at the next N reads 'highest passing N = N; next N held', no ceiling claim. A pass at N=4 reads 'no ceiling found up to 4', never '4 is the ceiling'.
claims.external_validity: the 13 tasks were chosen because they revert cleanly and touch disjoint files, so textual conflicts will be rare; the result speaks to easy-to-integrate work only

throughput_cost_tradeoff: the cost ratio bound is the tradeoff; the owner may change any threshold before launch only, which changes this file's sha256 and must be re-recorded in the ledger
